subject: BUG-248: 52 Operator missions record no progress (operator decision needed)
description:
All 50 js-*.mission.html plus python-01/02 never load ModuleProgress.js, so OperatorEngine's completion hook (OperatorEngine.js:794-811) is skipped and finishing them records no XP and no progress. 72 of 124 mission pages DO load it; python-03 through python-50 have it. Looks like an authoring batch, not a decision. The missions are listed as live in the operator hub. QUESTION FOR THE OPERATOR: are these meant to grant progress at all? The engine calls the hook unconditionally, which implies yes, but no spec was found and that is inference. If yes, the fix is one script tag per file. Also here: OperatorEngine.js:835 guards window.GameTracker, which is a top-level const with no window export, so that guard is permanently false; inert either way since no mission page loads GameTracker.js. Dead integration that reads as working code. See BUG_TRACKER BUG-248.
[2026-09-03 23:54] RESOLVED in 4c6eba9f7. Operator confirmed authoring gap. One script tag x52, copied from the 72 working pages. Verified in a browser with controls both ways (js-01 guard FALSE before, true after; progress written, silent:true suppresses the overlay). Gated by _tools/operator/mission-progress-wiring.gate.js in post-verify.sh, mutation-tested. GameTracker half NOT fixed: guard permanently false (const with no window export) and no mission loads it, so wiring it is a product decision. Spawned BUG-253 (taskboard 339).
